describes: packages/plugin/render: keys, conformance, the raster store, epochs, events, permissions.

cases.name: keys-continuous-exact
cases.covers: Under continuous the base renders the exact demand up to the 640 budget: keys, conformed viewports, epochs, policy and paint settings, with the page width converting scale to device px.

cases.name: keys-ladder-quantize
cases.covers: A continuous policy with a client width ladder snaps UP the sorted rungs and caps at the top rung.

cases.name: ladder-over-budget-keeps-the-smallest-rung
cases.covers: A client ladder whose every rung exceeds maxWidth keeps its smallest rung rather than none.

cases.name: lattice-default-budget
cases.covers: An advertised lattice (read from render.policy at open) is the deployment’s ladder: the default budget never filters it, zoom inside a rung keeps the key, crossing a rung changes it.

cases.name: lattice-explicit-budget-filters
cases.covers: An explicit maxWidth filters the advertised ladder (the mobile-memory knob); rungs above it are never asked for.

cases.name: format-conforms-and-warns-once
cases.covers: A strategy format the lattice does not list conforms to the deployment’s first format, joins the key, reaches the engine, and warns once.

args: [render] format 'bmp' is not in the deployment's formats — using 'webp'.

cases.name: format-rides-under-continuous
cases.covers: Under continuous the strategy format and quality apply as written, and the format is part of the raster identity.

cases.name: format-listed-by-the-lattice
cases.covers: A format the lattice lists is kept, with no warning.

cases.name: render-page-conformed-and-collapsed
cases.covers: renderPage sends the conformed viewport; same-key asks collapse onto one engine call (singleflight); a re-ask after resolution is served from the store; another annotations flag is another raster.

cases.name: render-page-failure-is-not-sticky
cases.covers: An engine failure rejects every attached consumer with the engine’s error and drops the entry, so the next ask fetches again.

cases.name: signal-one-consumer-aborts
cases.covers: A consumer abandoning a shared in-flight fetch rejects with its signal’s reason and detaches; the engine call stays alive for the signal-less consumer, who resolves.

cases.name: signal-last-consumer-aborts-the-engine-call
cases.covers: The last live consumer leaving an unresolved fetch aborts the engine call (the store’s reason reaches the engine) and drops the entry; a late answer is ignored and the next ask fetches fresh.

cases.name: signal-already-aborted
cases.covers: A pre-aborted signal rejects at once, but the fetch it created is already running and unowned: a later signal-less ask joins it, and it lands in the store.

cases.name: signal-after-resolution-is-a-no-op
cases.covers: An abort after the fetch resolved changes nothing: the consumer already resolved, and the raster stays cached.

cases.name: signal-consumer-sees-the-engine-failure
cases.covers: A signal-bearing consumer attached to a fetch that fails rejects with the engine error, and its later abort does nothing.

cases.name: eviction-by-cost
cases.covers: The store budget (128 MiB) is cost, not count: a URL-style handle costs width × height, bytes their length, anything else 1. Over budget, the oldest consumer-free resolved entry goes first; a just-resolved entry whose consumers have not yet run is spared.

cases.name: eviction-stops-once-under-budget
cases.covers: Eviction walks candidates oldest first and stops as soon as the ledger is back under budget, keeping the younger ones.

cases.name: eviction-spares-in-flight-entries
cases.covers: Entries still in flight are never evicted, and a zero-cost handle never pushes anything out.

cases.name: permission-denied
cases.covers: The twin: canRender mirrors doc.render, and a denied renderPage rejects locally with PermissionDenied (context render.renderPage) before conforming or calling the engine; keys stay computable.

cases.name: wildcard-allows-render
cases.covers: A wildcard grant renders.

cases.name: unknown-page-throws
cases.covers: A pon the registry does not know throws synchronously from renderPage, renderSourceKey and conformViewport (it is a programmer error, not a rejection).

cases.name: engine-refuses-a-registered-page
cases.covers: A page the registry lists but the handle refuses: doc.page throws inside the store’s fetch, so renderPage throws the EngineError synchronously and nothing is cached.

cases.name: epochs-and-invalidate
cases.covers: invalidate: content reaches both products, annotations only the annotated one; no pons means every page; an empty list dispatches nothing; epochs mint new keys.

cases.name: events-bump-the-ledger
cases.covers: The effect maps each confirmed document event to the pages whose rasters it staled: annotation and form events bump the annotated ledger, an applied redaction the content ledger, pages and metadata events nothing; coarse form results bump every page of the current registry; closing unsubscribes.

cases.name: budget-warning-without-tiles
cases.covers: With the tile plane disabled, a demand more than twice the base budget warns once (the page rests blurry); paintSettings says tiles are off and the plane never engages.

args: [render] demand is 7.7× over the base budget and the tile plane is disabled (tiles: false) — the page rests blurry. Raise fullPage.maxWidth or re-enable tiles.

cases.name: budget-warning-needs-a-deficit
cases.covers: The tiles-off warning measures the demand against what the base supplies: a demand at the budget never warns.

args: [render] demand is 2.4× over the base budget and the tile plane is disabled (tiles: false) — the page rests blurry. Raise fullPage.maxWidth or re-enable tiles.

cases.name: paint-settings-resolve
cases.covers: paintSettings reports the resolved fade and tile switch.

cases.name: close-with-a-render-in-flight
cases.covers: Closing the document removes the ledger; a render already in flight still resolves its consumer when the engine answers.
